newsitem.title: USA: Homestyle sees '96 earnings at $3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Homestyle sees '96 earnings at $3 mln.

text.p: Homestyle Harmony Inc and its Catalyst Communications Inc subsidiary said on Thursday they expected sales of $14 million and pre-tax earnings of $3 million in 1996.

For the first quarter 1997, the company said it forecast gross sales of $80 million with gross profits of $18.2 million. The two Homestyle Harmony restaurants contributed about $1.5 million in sales and $200,000 in profit to the 1997 first quarter forecast, the copmany said.
